meta.title: HOBYD — Live Auction for Collectors
meta.description: Real-time live auctions for Indonesian collectors.

auth.title: Log in to start bidding.
auth.description: Use the email and password for your registered demo account.
auth.unavailable: Login is unavailable. Check the configuration and try again.

lobby.title: Enter a live auction.
lobby.description: See what collectors are bidding on, enter a room, and place your best bid.
lobby.startDescription: Add a room name, category, and an optional thumbnail.
lobby.thumbnailKeep: Leave empty to keep the current thumbnail.
lobby.loginToStart: Log in to start your live and watch other collectors.

room.title: Pokémon TCG Night Auction
room.cameraOff: Video unavailable. You can still bid.
room.endLiveBlocked: Finish the active item before ending your live.
room.endLiveFailed: Could not end the live. Try again.
room.videoLoginRequired: Log in to watch the video.
room.noActiveItem: No active item yet. The seller can create one after the room is live.

item.goLiveSuccess: The room is live. You can create an item now.
item.liveRequired: Use Go Live before creating an item.

bid.historyEmpty: No bids yet. Be the first.
bid.help: Enter a whole IDR amount above the current bid. The server validates the amount and timestamp.
bid.tooLow: Your bid must exceed the current price.
bid.rateLimited: Wait one second before your next bid.
bid.loginRequired: Log in to place a bid.

win.title: ITEM WON
win.description: The highest bid has been locked as the winner.
win.noWinner: The auction closed with no bids. There is no winner or payment order.

pay.title: Complete your payment.
pay.qrHelp: Use a sandbox payment app. Never use real funds for this demo.
pay.qrLoadFailed: QRIS is not available yet. Try again without creating a new order.
pay.mockHelp: Use only as a sandbox fallback when the webhook cannot receive notifications locally.
pay.paidHelp: The server verifies the confirmation status and payment time.
pay.actionFailed: Payment is not confirmed yet. Check the status and try again.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.notFound: The requested data was not found.
errors.tooLow: Your bid must exceed the current price.
errors.rateLimited: Too fast. Wait one second and try again.
errors.upstream: A service is unavailable. Try again.
errors.invalidImage: Use a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image up to 5MB.
